The '''Mauler Bunker''' was an underground facility located a short distance west of the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]] in the [[Lasay Swamp]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] used by the [[Maulers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the bunker to retrieve a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact stolen by the Maulers. Several Maulers, including [[Driton Fitch]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mauler Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mauler Bunker was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
